options: The output lies between 0 and 1, and can be read as a probability
explain: The sigmoid squashes any real number into (0, 1).

q: Why scale features before gradient descent?
options: Unequal scales make the error surface stretched and slow to descend
explain: With similar scales, one learning rate suits all the weights.

q: Gradient descent and logistic regression are:
